nb76a43e233.headline: Ex-rebel sworn in as Colombia's president in historic shift
nb76a43e233.summary: Colombia's first leftist president will be sworn in on Sunday, promising to fight inequality and marking a turning point in the country's history.
nb76a43e233.why: Colombia is a major oil and coal exporter, and changes in government policy on energy, taxation and mining shape the outlook for the country's sovereign debt and peso.
